summary.text: Daniel Popovici-Muller is a Republican member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives from Rockingham 17 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election after advancing from the September 8 primary.
Popovici-Muller is a certified public accountant, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Daniel Popovici-Muller graduated from Colegiul National I.L.Caragiale in Bucharest, Romania, in 1985, and obtained an M.S. in electronics and telecommunications from the University Politehnica of Bucharest in 1992.
He earned an M.B.A. from Boston University in 2008.

His career experience includes working as a finance manager for Praxair Healthcare Services in Waltham, Massachusetts; as finance director of the Town of Windham, New Hampshire; and owning his own business as a certified public accountant.
Ballotpedia lists Popovici-Muller's tenure in the New Hampshire House of Representatives as beginning in 2022, succeeding Marcia Moody (D) in the Rockingham 17 seat.
